name: Video to Video
description: Video to Video is a short starting page: a title banner and a 'Transform Your Videos' section whose buttons open Video Studio, where you attach your clip and transform it.
shortDescription: Starting page for video-to-video; the work happens in Video Studio.
fullDescription: Video to Video (#/video-to-video) is a starting page, not an editor. It shows a banner titled 'Video to Video' ('Transform and enhance your videos with AI-powered tools') and a 'Transform Your Videos' section ('Start editing your videos with powerful AI tools. Upload a clip in Video Studio to restyle it, extend it or remove a watermark.') with two buttons: 'Get Started Free' opens Video Studio (#/video), and '🎯 GTM Boost' helps you write a marketing prompt and then opens Video Studio with it in the prompt box. There is no upload, prompt box or Generate button on this page. In Video Studio, attach a video with the video button (tooltip 'Upload video to remove watermark'): the studio switches to its video-to-video model list (77 entries; the first is AI Video Watermark Remover), with workflows such as Edit video, Extend uploaded video and Motion transfer.
bestFor: Anyone who wants to transform a clip they already have; this page points you to Video Studio, where the video-to-video tools are.
whenToUse: You want to start a video-to-video job (watermark removal, edit, extend, motion transfer) and need the way in.
You want GTM Boost to write a marketing-style video prompt before you open Video Studio.
whenToUseAnother: Use Video Studio (#/video) to attach a video and run watermark removal, edit, extend or motion transfer.
Use Video Tools (#/videotools) for other video utilities.
Use Upscale Suite (#/upscale) to increase resolution.
keyFeatures: 'Transform Your Videos' section with 'Get Started Free', which opens Video Studio.
'🎯 GTM Boost' prompt helper that opens Video Studio with the prompt filled in.
Video Studio's video upload button switches it to video-to-video models.

featureExplanations.explanation: The page opens with a banner titled 'Video to Video' and the line 'Transform and enhance your videos with AI-powered tools'.

Below the banner, the 'Transform Your Videos' section says 'Start editing your videos with powerful AI tools. Upload a clip in Video Studio to restyle it, extend it or remove a watermark.' Its 'Get Started Free' button opens Video Studio (#/video).
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Fastest way from this page to the video-to-video tools.
featureExplanations.restrictions: It only opens Video Studio; nothing is uploaded or generated here. Video Studio opens in text-to-video until you attach a video.

featureExplanations.explanation: The '🎯 GTM Boost' button next to 'Get Started Free' opens the GTM Boost window ('🎯 GTM Boost · Video to Video'). You write your idea, pick an angle, audience and goal, and click the Boost button to get a conversion-focused prompt. 'Apply' closes the window and opens Video Studio with that prompt already in the prompt box.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Turn a rough marketing idea into a ready-to-use prompt before you start.
featureExplanations.inputRequired: An idea in step 1 (otherwise the window says 'Add your ... idea first.').
featureExplanations.restrictions: Without an OpenAI key the window shows 'Add your OpenAI key for AI-written results. Until then GTM Boost uses a built-in template.' The prompt is not attached to any video: add your clip in Video Studio yourself.

featureExplanations.explanation: In Video Studio, the video button (tooltip 'Upload video to remove watermark') attaches a video. The studio then switches to its video-to-video list, whose first model is 'AI Video Watermark Remover'; other workflows include Edit video, Extend uploaded video and Motion transfer.
featureExplanations.restrictions: Video uploads are limited to 50MB (shared upload limits). Some workflows need a prompt or a character image; see the Video Studio guide.

howToUse: 1. Open Video to Video (#/video-to-video). 2. Click 'Get Started Free' to open Video Studio, or click '🎯 GTM Boost' to write a prompt first and click Apply. 3. In Video Studio, click the video button (tooltip 'Upload video to remove watermark') and attach your clip. 4. The studio switches to video-to-video models; pick a workflow or model. 5. Add a prompt if the model needs one and click Generate.
howToSteps: Click 'Get Started Free' (or use GTM Boost and Apply).
In Video Studio, attach your video with the video button.
Choose a video-to-video model or workflow.
Add a prompt if required and click Generate.
gettingStarted: Click 'Get Started Free' and attach a short clip in Video Studio.
Try the default AI Video Watermark Remover, which needs no prompt.
requiredInputs: None on this page; a video file is needed in Video Studio.

useCases.title: Getting to the video-to-video tools

faqs.question: Can I upload a video on this page?
faqs.answer: No. Click 'Get Started Free' to open Video Studio and attach your video there with the video button.

faqs.question: What does GTM Boost do here?
faqs.answer: It turns your idea into a marketing-focused video prompt and, when you click Apply, opens Video Studio with that prompt in the prompt box.

glossary.Video-to-video: Making a new or changed video from a video you supply.
glossary.Watermark remover: A model that removes logos, captions or overlay text from a clip.
glossary.GTM Boost: A helper window that rewrites your idea as a marketing-focused video prompt (GTM = go-to-market).

tips: Keep clips under 50MB before attaching them in Video Studio.
Use GTM Boost when you need help wording the edit prompt.
bestPractices: Treat this page as a starting point; do the upload and generation in Video Studio.
